List/view past wave results from .wombo-combo/history/

Wave history is auto-exported when a wave completes. Records are stored separately from .wombo-combo/daemon-state.json and survive cleanup. Use without arguments to list all waves, or pass a wave ID to see detailed results.

Aliases: `h`

```sh
woco history [wave-id] [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wave-id` | no | Specific wave ID to show details for (optional) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
